headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorIdeal_success
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L)]
  (C : ℕ),
  (∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c), C ≤ Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount r c U L X) →
    1 - (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorIdealLaw r c U L C).mass none =
      ↑(Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)) * ↑C /
        ↑(Fintype.card (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorTrial_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hrLarge : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hcLarge : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
          ∀ (C : ℕ) (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ),
            OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorTrialLaw r c U L hrLarge hcLarge C start h k)
                (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorIdealLaw r c U L C) ≤
              Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic k

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorRetry_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hrLarge : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hcLarge : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
          ∀ (C : ℕ),
            (∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c), C ≤ Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount r c U L X) →
              ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ)
                (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c) (R : ℕ),
                ∀ s ≤ 1 - (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorIdealLaw r c U L C).mass none,
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorRetryLaw r c U L hrLarge hcLarge C start h k fallback
                        R)
                      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
                    (1 - s) ^ R + ↑R * (Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic k)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalAugmentedNumerator_le_count
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  1 ≤ L →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
      (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
        ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
          Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.augmentedInverseSupportAllowance r c U ≤
            Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount r c U L X

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.augmentedInverseSupportAllowance_ratio_lower
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ),
  2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
    have p :=
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U));
    1 / (2 * ↑p) ≤ ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.augmentedInverseSupportAllowance r c U) / ↑(2 * (p * (p - 1)))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualShape_terminalAugmented_success_lower
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ)
  [inst :
    Nonempty
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c
        (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)) 7)],
  2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c
            (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)))) →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
      (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
        1 /
            (2 *
              ↑(Fintype.card
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c
                      (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)))))) ≤
          1 -
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorIdealLaw r c
                  (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)) 7
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.augmentedInverseSupportAllowance r c
                    (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)))).mass
              none

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualShape_terminalAugmentedRetry_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ)
  (hrLarge :
    0 <
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices
          (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2), List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hcLarge :
    0 <
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices
          (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2), List.ofFn c)).length),
  2 ≤ m →
    2 ≤ n →
      ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c
                  (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)))) →
          (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
            (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
              ∀
                (start :
                  Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c
                    (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)) 7)
                (h k : ℕ) (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c) (R : ℕ),
                OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalNumeratorRetryLaw r c
                      (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)) 7 hrLarge hcLarge
                      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.augmentedInverseSupportAllowance r c
                        (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance * (m + n - 2)))
                      start h k fallback R)
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
                  (1 -
                        1 /
                          (2 *
                            ↑(Fintype.card
                                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c
                                    (11 * OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance *
                                      (m + n - 2))))))) ^
                      R +
                    ↑R * (Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic k)
